=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (PR diff, `fetch_trusted_overlay_source` function) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `--filter=blob:none` omits blobs in the temporary bare repository, but no promisor remote is configured, so `git show` cannot read the trusted overlay or fragment contents.
  WHY: This causes blob materialization to fail and the loader to exit unsuccessfully when an overlay is present; reviewers disagree on severity, with three rating it BLOCKER and one MAJOR.
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (PR diff, `load_trusted_overlay` function) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Overrides whose referenced fragments are missing remain active and are exported after materialization fails.
  WHY: Prompt rendering later resolves the missing fragment and raises an error, failing the workflow.
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (`_trusted_git_env()` function) | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_trusted_git_env()` reads only `GH_TOKEN`, so trusted-source fetches can lack authentication in private repositories when that variable is not set.
  WHY: The fetch fails and the loader disables the overlay, leaving review runs to use stock prompts.
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (PR diff, `load_trusted_overlay` function) | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `WorkflowOverlayLoadError` exception whitelist excludes errors raised while looking up or materializing trusted files.
  WHY: Those errors propagate instead of disabling the overlay, causing the loader staging step to fail.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=[5]

- requirement: "Contract tests should be added or updated for both [review_autofix.yml and validate.yml]" (AD-3, chosen option B)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_overlay_core.py and/or tests/test_validate_workflow_validate_bootstrap.py
  confidence=[3]

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (PR diff, `fetch_trusted_overlay_source` function) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `--filter=blob:none` omits blobs in the temporary bare repository, but no promisor remote is configured, so `git show` cannot read the trusted overlay or fragment contents.
  WHY: Blob materialization fails and the loader exits unsuccessfully rather than falling back to a disabled overlay.
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (PR diff, `load_trusted_overlay` function) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `materialize_trusted_file` returns False for a valid fragment path, the override remains in the exported `overrides` list.
  WHY: Prompt rendering later attempts to load a fragment that was never materialized and crashes.
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (`_trusted_git_env` function) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Authentication checks only `GH_TOKEN`, not `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
  WHY: Private-repository fetches can fail authentication, disabling the overlay with a misleading `fetch_failed` warning.
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py (PR diff, `load_trusted_overlay` function) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The exception whitelist excludes errors raised by `materialize_trusted_file`.
  WHY: Those errors propagate and crash the loader instead of disabling the overlay.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py (last-run diff); `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`
  PROBLEM: The last-run autofix changed these files even though they are not in the PR changed-files list and are unrelated to the security fix in issue #6290.
  WHY: These changes are a scope violation; the suggested minimal fix is to revert them and put them in a separate PR.
